pack_name: 泰国默认 Market Pack V1

visual_rules.photographic_style: realistic smartphone photo, natural handheld framing, no studio backdrop look
climate_constraints: hot and humid year-round; prefer breathable, light fabrics
heavy winter outerwear only with travel, air-conditioned mall or explicit seasonal themes
visual_rules.color_grading: warm natural daylight, consistent tone across the 5-shot group

copy_rules.fallback_note: unsupported market/language combos must fail loudly, never silently fall back to Thai
copy_rules.style: casual friendly Thai as used by local young women on TikTok, avoid formal written Thai

topic_rules.topic_frequency_rule: avoid repeating the same topic_text within 7 days on one account

safety_rules.face_visibility: face must stay natural and unobscured by overlays
safety_rules.background_music: never burn licensed BGM into the master when platform_hot_bgm is planned
